metadata.name: Pleistocene and Pliocene sediment core geochemistry dataset
metadata.description: Geochemical and isotopic measurements (e.g., Al, Ca, Fe, K, Mn, Na, P, Mo, U, TOC, δ15N, δ13C, δ98Mo) from sediment cores collected at site 112‑680A (latitude -11.065, longitude -78.07783) during a single sampling event on 5 November 1986. The dataset includes depth, core identifiers, and a range of elemental ratios for both Pleistocene and Pliocene intervals.
